title: Aaron Glenn believes Geno Smith will lead Jets ‘to the promised land’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn believes Geno Smith will lead Jets ‘to the promised land’
sources.description: Speaking to reporters at the 2026 NFL Annual League Meeting on Tuesday morning, Jets head coach Aaron Glenn had a chance to voice his opinion on a few topics relating to the upcoming season, none more pertinent than his confidence in new quarterback Geno Smith.
